, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted “Helsingfors” (the Swedish name for Helsinki) as referring to “Helsingborg” and proposed normalizing the birthplace to “Helsingborg, Sweden.” This is wrong—the correct birthplace is Helsinki, Finland (Helsingfors in Swedish), historically in the Grand Duchy of Finland, Russian Empire.
